author: Buw
body:
Yo guys I am kinda low key looking for team, wont prioritise you guys over Grim (my OCN team) or Grime (my Avicus team) but because of Grim Grime is gonna be inactive af and I kinda wanna meet new people in avicus teams.

Im a good shotcaller and shit, been leading teams for more than a year, I am good at both bow and sword and can hold my own against practically anyone. But also I am an experienced defender and can do that if needed too. If you want to trial me or talk to me add me on skype (elvi5h_presley) ik its a shitty skype name but wth.

someone good take me plz
